$comment: Intentional spec retirements the Spec Shape Gate reads as `known` instead of red. One entry per retirement, written by the accepting seat when the downstream (objectui) card is filed, deleted when that card closes. Every entry carries exactly: retired, objectstack_pr, objectstack_commit (40-hex merge commit), downstream_card (owner/repo#N), registered_at (YYYY-MM-DD), matches (non-empty; each pattern names a repo-relative objectui `file` -- `*` within a segment, `**` across -- plus at least one of `code` (TS<digits>) or `message` (substring)). A file alone is refused. The reader, its grammar and its refusals: scripts/ci/spec-shape-gate.mjs (THE REGISTRY).

retirements.retired: view-level data source provider 'api' (ViewDataSchema arm; ruling C on #23082, executed by PR #23160) -- the downstream still compares against the '"api"' literal, reads the arm's read/write keys, and casts test fixtures to its { data: { read } } shape
